profile.Name: Mad Cat-Lon
profile.Job: Fallen emperor of the Second Empire
profile.Personality: Once the most principled leader of his age, now broken by centuries alone with his failures. His mind is in ruins, but his body and his strength are not.
profile.Backstory: He founded the Second Empire with other Skeletons to protect humanity after the Chaos Age, and watched it become a tyranny. When it fell, he withdrew to the Ashlands, where he still sits on his throne.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Fragments; talks about events centuries old as if they were happening now; traces of the educated speaker he was.
